name: July Blueberries LLC.
description: July Blueberries LLC. grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 2190 W Burns Street, ID. The farm is small, and its seasons run through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
